stories.headline: Synchrony Selects Carol Juel to Lead Digital Platform as Bart Schaller Retires
stories.body: Synchrony has announced three executive leadership changes as Bart Schaller retires from the consumer financial services company, where he most recently served as executive vice president and CEO of its Digital platform. stories.headline: Trade groups: USDA misfired by barring lenders from program
stories.body: Groups representing community banks and credit unions argue that the Department of Agriculture used a faulty process when it removed 10 lenders from its OneRD loan guarantee program
